description: Read the Custom SQL Pools configuration for a workspace (governs all warehouses in it). Custom SQL Pools cap the maximum share of warehouse compute a classified workload can consume — for workload isolation/governance, not as a spending cap. Pair with 'warehouse update-sql-pools-config' to apply a configuration.
notes: This illustrates the LEGACY response, not a guarantee that customSQLPoolsEnabled is present. The announced unified model returns only effective pools and retires the flag (mid-December 2026 client preparation; January 2027 rollout). Never treat an omitted flag as disabled or expect GET to retain inactive pools. The route is workspace-scoped and needs no beta parameter. Classifier type accepts Application Name, Application Name Regex, and Statement Type. Save raw JSON privately, review the target rollout contract and complete pool list, then preview update-sql-pools-config. Fabio does not add a mode flag. See custom-sql-pools.
